actions.add_row_to_sheet.description: Adds a new contact or record to a selected contact list (sheet).
actions.add_row_to_sheet.props.instructi:
### How to Add a Row
1. Select the target sheet above.
2. Enter the row data below using column names as keys and the cell values as values.
actions.add_row_to_sheet.props.rowData.d: Key-value pairs representing the new row. Keys should match the sheet column names. Example: { "Email": "john@example.com", "First Name": "John" }
actions.add_row_to_sheet.props.sheet.des: Select the contact list (sheet) to use.
actions.create_webhook.description: Registers a new webhook in Sendr to receive event notifications.
Optional metadata attributes for the webhook.
actions.create_webhook.props.events.desc: List of event names to subscribe to (e.g. page_render:created, contact_page_engagement:created).
actions.create_webhook.props.name.descri: A human-readable name for the webhook.
Optional resource ID filter for the webhook.
actions.create_webhook.props.resourceTyp: Optional resource type filter for the webhook.
actions.create_webhook.props.url.descrip: The endpoint URL that Sendr will call when events occur.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_webhook.description: Deletes a registered Sendr webhook by its URL.
actions.generate_sendr_page.description: Creates a personalized Sendr landing page from a template with custom variables.
actions.generate_sendr_page.props.attrib: Optional metadata attributes for the generated page (key-value pairs).
actions.generate_sendr_page.props.instru:
### How to Generate a Page
1. Choose a **Page Template** below.
2. Fill in the variable values (e.g. first_name = "Anna", company = "Acme").
3. Optionally provide a website URL to screenshot, or enable GIF/audio rendering.
actions.generate_sendr_page.props.render: If enabled, Sendr will generate an animated GIF version of the page.
actions.generate_sendr_page.props.templa: Select a Sendr Page template to generate content from.
actions.generate_sendr_page.props.variab: Key-value pairs matching the template variables. Example: { "first_name": "Anna", "company": "Acme Inc" }
actions.generate_sendr_page.props.webhoo: Optional callback URL to receive status updates (e.g. when GIF or audio is ready).
actions.generate_sendr_page.props.websit: Optional. Provide a website URL if the template supports background screenshots.
actions.get_campaign.description: Returns detailed information about a specific campaign.
actions.get_page_template_variables.desc: Returns the custom variables (placeholders) defined in a selected page template � for example first_name, company, or email.
actions.get_page_template_variables.prop: Select a Sendr Page template to generate content from.
actions.get_sheet.description: Returns details of a specific contact list (sheet).
actions.get_sheet.props.sheet.descriptio: Select the contact list (sheet) to use.
actions.get_sheet_columns.description: Returns all columns (fields) of a contact list, including their enrichment status.
actions.get_sheet_columns.props.sheet.de: Select the contact list (sheet) to use.
actions.get_user_info.description: Returns information about the currently connected Sendr API user. Useful for verifying that your API key is valid.
actions.list_campaigns.description: Lists all campaigns in your Sendr workspace, optionally filtered by status.
actions.list_campaigns.props.status.desc: Filter campaigns by their current status.
actions.list_page_templates.description: Lists all available Sendr Page templates you can use to create personalized landing pages.
actions.list_sheets.description: Lists all available contact lists (sheets) in your Sendr workspace.
actions.list_webhooks.description: Lists all registered webhooks in your Sendr workspace.
actions.queue_dynamic_audio.description: Queues a job to generate personalized audio by replacing a target word in a base audio file.
actions.queue_dynamic_audio.props.audioU: Public URL of the base audio file to personalize.
actions.queue_dynamic_audio.props.eleven: Optional ElevenLabs voice ID for the generated audio.
actions.queue_dynamic_audio.props.replac: The word to insert in place of the target word (e.g. "Anna").
actions.queue_dynamic_audio.props.target: The word to find and replace in the audio (e.g. "first_name" or "[NAME]").
actions.queue_dynamic_audio.props.webhoo: Optional callback URL to receive status updates when the audio job is done.
actions.queue_video_generation.descripti: Queues a job to merge audio and video or generate a lipsync video.
actions.queue_video_generation.props.aud: Public URL of the audio track to use.
actions.queue_video_generation.props.mux: Optional Mux asset ID for the video source.
actions.queue_video_generation.props.pag: Optional Sendr Page slug to associate with this video.
actions.queue_video_generation.props.vid: Public URL of the base video to use.
actions.queue_video_generation.props.web: Optional callback URL to receive status updates when the video job is done.
actions.reveal_webhook_secret.descriptio: Reveals the secret key for a registered webhook so you can verify incoming signatures.
actions.toggle_webhook.description: Enables or disables a registered Sendr webhook.
actions.toggle_webhook.props.enabled.des: Check to enable the webhook, uncheck to disable it.
actions.update_webhook.description: Updates an existing Sendr webhook by its URL.
actions.update_webhook.props.events.desc: Updated list of event names to subscribe to.
auth.description:
**How to get your API key:**
1. Log in to your Sendr dashboard at https://app.sendr.io.
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**.
3. Click **Create New Key**.
4. Copy the key and paste it below.

Need help? Contact Sendr support at https://sendr.io/support
description: Create personalized landing pages, dynamic audio, video, and manage campaigns with Sendr.
triggers.contact_page_engagement_created: Triggers when a contact visits a Sendr Page for the first time.
triggers.contact_page_engagement_updated: Triggers when a contact interacts with a Sendr Page again (e.g. replays, re-visits).
triggers.page_render_created.description: Triggers when a new Sendr Page is rendered.
triggers.page_render_updated.description: Triggers when a Sendr Page render is updated (e.g. GIF or audio is ready).
